Better Direct is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to build and improve its internal CRM and business systems. The role develops and maintains features across frontend, backend, database, storage, and integration layers, with responsibility for reliable workflows and production outcomes.
Hardware
Information Technology
Information Services
No H1B
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Build and maintain features using React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Prisma, and PostgreSQL
Translate business workflows into clear, reliable technical solutions
Work across frontend, backend, database, storage, and integration layers
Design APIs, database schemas, validations, and permission controls
Protect data integrity for customer, financial, inventory, and order information
Diagnose root causes across the system rather than only fixing visible symptoms
Handle migrations, backfills, concurrent updates, and failure scenarios safely
Integrate external APIs with appropriate retries, timeouts, idempotency, and error handling
Consider performance in queries, APIs, background jobs, and user-facing workflows
Write tests for business rules, permissions, edge cases, and failure conditions
Debug production issues using logs, database records, and system behavior
Review code for correctness, security, maintainability, and impact on existing workflows
Document important technical decisions and communicate changes clearly
Own focused features from requirements through release and production verification
Qualification

Required
United States citizenship is required for this position
1–2 years of professional software development experience
Strong working knowledge of React and TypeScript
Experience building backend services with Node.js, Express, and REST APIs
Solid understanding of SQL, PostgreSQL, and relational data modeling
Ability to navigate an existing codebase before making changes
Understanding of API design, validation, error handling, and secure coding practices
Familiarity with authentication and role-based authorization
Experience with Git, testing, code review, and debugging
Experience using AI coding tools while independently validating their output
Ability to explain technical decisions, risks, and uncertainties clearly
Practical understanding of how applications behave in development and production
Systems thinking: understanding how application layers and integrations work together
Data correctness: preventing duplicate, missing, inconsistent, or unauthorized changes
Problem-solving: finding root causes and comparing practical solutions
Scalability awareness: recognizing designs that may become slow or difficult to maintain
Production ownership: verifying releases and responding when issues occur
Business understanding: learning why a workflow exists, not only how to implement it
Maintainability: writing code that other engineers can understand and extend
Good judgment: knowing when to proceed, investigate further, or ask for help
curiosity, disciplined thinking, a willingness to learn quickly, and steady growth toward greater technical ownership

Python, FastAPI, Celery, Redis, Selenium, or pytest
Performance analysis, database indexing, or query optimization
CI/CD, application monitoring, structured logging, or production deployments
Third-party business, catalog, ordering, or payment API integrations
